facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Fully funded residency for selected fellows: housing covered; program is not an investment
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; 0% IP; no obligation to start a company
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Selected builder/fellow; first cohort up to 15 people.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Arrive SF Sep 17, 2026; main program Sep 21 for two weeks.
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-idea–early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: High-signal network/residency opportunity rather than a financing accelerator.

facts.Funding / Support: Fully funded residency for selected fellows: housing covered; program is not an investment

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Selected builder/fellow; first cohort up to 15 people.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.

facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: High-signal network/residency opportunity rather than a financing accelerator.
